subject.title: [Feature]: Batch WhatsApp messages by messageTimestamp instead of receive time

question: Should WhatsApp add timestamp-aware text coalescing, and if so should it be opt-in or default with what timestamp tolerance and maximum hold?
rationale: Source proves the missing behavior and owner boundary, but acceptable added latency, second-level timestamp collisions, default upgrade behavior, and config precedence are product choices rather than mechanically derivable fixes.

options.title: Opt-in bounded coalescing
options.body: Add a disabled-by-default WhatsApp account/channel option with strict identity keys, a documented timestamp tolerance, and a hard maximum hold.

options.title: Default bounded coalescing
options.body: Enable timestamp-aware grouping for existing WhatsApp users and explicitly accept the upgrade-visible latency and grouping change.

options.title: Keep receive-time only
options.body: Retain the existing debounce contract and document larger debounce windows as the supported workaround.

recommendation.title: Opt-in bounded coalescing
recommendation.body: Add a disabled-by-default WhatsApp account/channel option with strict identity keys, a documented timestamp tolerance, and a hard maximum hold.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the existing product review and has the strongest shared debounce and documentation history among the identified candidates.
